create_pipeline_stable_diffusion_pag: create a StableDiffusionPAGPipeline instance for text-to-image generation with Perturbed Attention Guidance
run_perturbed_attention_guidance: run image generation using PAG with configurable pag_scale and pag_applied_layers_index parameters
configure_pag_cfg_combined: configure both classifier-free guidance and perturbed attention guidance for enhanced image generation
set_adaptive_pag_scaling: set adaptive PAG scaling that adjusts signal_scale dynamically based on timestep during denoising
swap_attention_processors: swap UNet attention processors to PAGIdentitySelfAttnProcessor or PAGCFGIdentitySelfAttnProcessor for self-attention layers
